note: ⛔ SNG-446. THE POWER COSMOLOGY — Erik, 2026-08-15. This is the frame the four sources hang from, and it was not written down anywhere.

theSymmetry._statement:
⛔ CRYSTAL-BASED POWER HAS TWO SIDES, AND EACH HAS A PURE FORM AND A HUMAN ACCESS METHOD.
   PRECURSOR SIDE — pure form: THE LATTICE SUBSTRATE. Human access: NANITES.
   METAPHYSICAL SIDE — pure form: THE VEIL. Human access: THE METAPHYSICAL PRACTICES (ki, psychic, numen-work, stillness).
⚠️ ERIK: 'The nanites are how humans CLOSED THE GAP with the Precursors, prior to the Transition… the other metaphysics are new ways to access the power the Veil uses, just like the nanites are a new way to access or channel the Precursor power.'
⛔ SO NANITE AND METAPHYSICS ARE THE SAME KIND OF THING — both are HUMAN WORKAROUNDS, reaching a power we did not build, from two opposite directions. That is why nothing in this world is 'magic' and everything is a method.

metaphysical_pure.builtBy: ⛔ NOT BUILT — it is what remains where Kenosis stopped being present
metaphysical_pure.access: direct, and it is a breach

theSymmetry._consequence: ⚠️ THE VEIL IS TO METAPHYSICS WHAT THE LATTICE IS TO PRECURSOR — the pure case nobody can hold. ⛔ AND IT EXPLAINS THE VEILWRIGHTS: they are the one people working the pure form directly, which is why their craft is rare, why it is dangerous, and why thinning the Veil opens a breach rather than a door.

precursor_lattice.densestWhere: ⛔ where Precursor lines and structures are — buried relay, waygate, seamless join
precursor_lattice.map: substrateDensity, 0.12–0.98 across 39 regions. The Gearlands 0.98, the Quickwood 0.12.
precursor_lattice.note: ⚠️ It does not move and nobody makes more of it.

ordered_nanite.densestWhere: ⛔ where HUMAN ACTIVITY WAS — old works, cities, roads, yards, anywhere people processed things
ordered_nanite.note: ⚠️ Distinct from the lattice and mapped separately. `naniteField.byRegion` already carries state ordered/wild/clear across 39 regions.

wild_nanite.densestWhere: same origin as ordered — ungoverned rather than absent
wild_nanite.note: ⛔ NOT A DIFFERENT SUBSTANCE. The same nanites, differently processed.

metaphysical.densestWhere:
⛔ AT NEXUSES, AND A NEXUS CAN COME FROM SEVERAL SOURCES. Erik: 'a Buddhist temple, a medicine wheel near a standing stone, a sacrificial altar, etc. NATURAL OR UNNATURAL.'
⚠️ SO METAPHYSICAL DENSITY IS NOT A TERRAIN FUNCTION — it is a function of WHAT HAPPENED SOMEWHERE and what was built to mark it. A place is a nexus because of attention paid, not because of ground.

kinds.example: a standing stone, a spring, a thin place, a peak
kinds.how: the ground was already like that and people noticed

kinds.example: a temple, a medicine wheel, a burial field, a hall of vigil
kinds.how: ⚠️ MADE by sustained attention over time — the practice creates the nexus, not the architecture

kinds.example: ⛔ a sacrificial altar, a massacre site, a place where something enormous was done at once
kinds.how: made by a single act instead of long attention. ⚠️ Works, and is not the same as consecrated.

metaphysical._resolves: ⛔ THIS ANSWERS SNG-444. I had three canon statements that could not all be true because I was scoring metaphysical against SUBSTRATE density. It has its own field and always did — that is why the Numinous live at 0.82 and are not contradicting themselves.

theConversion._statement:
⛔ THE ORDERED/WILD SPLIT IS NOT A MAP FEATURE — IT IS A LIVE FACTIONAL ARGUMENT OVER ONE SHARED RESOURCE. Erik: 'Rootkin and Churnfolk tend to BREAK ORDERED NANITE DOWN INTO WILD as they use wild. Seraph and Enginewright do the opposite — ORDERING WILD while they use ordered nanite.'
⚠️ THE FIELD IS THEREFORE CONTESTED GROUND THAT MOVES. Two peoples working the same valley for a season leave it measurably different, and neither has to attack anything to do it.
theConversion._consequence: ⛔ THIS IS THE BEST THING ON THIS PAGE FOR PLAY. A Rootkin grove and an Enginewright works cannot share a district without one of them slowly losing their power source. ⚠️ No war declared, no villain — just two crafts that consume each other's fuel by existing. AND IT IS ALREADY HALF-AUTHORED: `naniteField.byRegion` reads ordered 21 · wild 10 · clear 8, and the 12 foothill regions I authored under SNG-414 set state per region for exactly this reason.

_poleNaming:
⛔ ERIK: 'You can INVERT THE POLE NAME so that Order is still Chaos's antipole. Enginecraft falls out of order and nanite systems naturally. And the Latticework practice is using ORDERED NANITES TO BASICALLY REPRODUCE WHAT PRECURSOR SUBSTRATE IS AND DOES.'
⚠️ SO THE TRADITION IS **ORDER**, not Mechanism, and Chaos keeps its antipode. Enginecraft and Latticework are its two sects — and Latticework is now precisely defined: HUMANS IMITATING THE LATTICE WITH NANITES. ⛔ Which makes the Lattice-Cities an act of homage to something that has never answered them.
theThinnings:
⛔ ERIK 2026-08-15: 'The THINNINGS are as old as the Precursor substrate, and are NEXUSES THAT ARE MEANT TO THIN THE VEIL so that the other side can come through. This is what Lucifer fell to wanting.'
⚠️ THIS TIES THREE THREADS THAT WERE RUNNING SEPARATELY:
   (1) THE VEIL IS WHAT REMAINS WHERE KENOSIS STOPPED BEING PRESENT (SNG-442). A Thinning is therefore a work aimed at the absence a dead sibling left.
   (2) THE DEMONIC/ANGELIC SPLIT IS THE PRECURSOR DISAGREEMENT — canon: 'an ancient disagreement between two entities of one people.' ⛔ NOW IT HAS A SUBJECT: one of them wanted the other side through, and built the apparatus for it.
   (3) THE THINNINGS ARE AS OLD AS THE SUBSTRATE. ⛔ SO THEY WERE BUILT BY THE SAME HANDS AND IN THE SAME AGE — the lattice and the Thinnings are one construction programme with two purposes, and Akinetos either permitted the second or did not notice it.
⚠️ AND THE LOCATION `the_thinning` IS ALREADY CANON AND ALREADY A TIER-2 WAYGATE. It is not named for an atmosphere. It is one of the works, still standing, and the Numinous sit beside it.
⛔ THE HORROR, PLAINLY: a Thinning is not a natural nexus that a people learned to use. It is a MACHINE FOR OPENING A DOOR, left running at low power for four centuries, and every metaphysical practitioner who has ever drawn on one has been helping.

theSoulEconomy._statement: ⛔ SNG-549. THE FLOOR UNDER THE WHOLE COSMOLOGY — Erik, 2026-09-12. **SOULS ARE POWER.** ⚠️ Everything above this key describes how power is REACHED. This is what is being reached for, and it was not written down anywhere. ⛔ ERIK, VERBATIM: 'souls are power. The lattice channels them, the veil uses them. Meaning is grown by them. Nanites were built by them.' ⚠️ FOUR VERBS ON ONE NOUN. The four fields were never four powers — they are four RELATIONSHIPS to a single one, which is why `theSymmetry` could say nanite and metaphysics are 'the same kind of thing, reaching a power we did not build, from two opposite directions' without ever naming the power.

theFourRelations.lattice: CHANNELS them. Akinetos's work is a conductor, and its density map is a map of where soul can be carried.
theFourRelations.veil: USES them. ⛔ See `_theWallsPrice` — this is the hardest line in the ruling and it is not yet resolved.
theFourRelations.meaning: IS GROWN BY them. ⚠️ Which makes the Numinous and the Veilwrights growers rather than finders, and makes a domain's manifestation an act of cultivation.
theFourRelations.nanites: WERE BUILT BY them. ⛔ Humans closed the gap with the Precursors by spending the one thing they had that the Precursors had seeded.

theSoulEconomy._whyTheWorldIsCalledExesa: ⛑ THIS EXPLAINS THE SETTING'S OLDEST AUTHORED FACT AND WAS NOT WRITTEN TO. `world_framing`: 'Nothing external ate this world. It was spent, by its own inhabitants, on their own workings, one working at a time — and the eating was small and everywhere.' ⛔ IF SOULS ARE POWER, THAT IS WHAT WAS SPENT. Every working ever cast was soul going out of the world. ⚠️ And the de-technologising stops being a cultural choice and becomes a WITHDRAWAL — Erik's authored line, 'the craving for power to fuel AI-driven nanotechnology works was insatiable, until the decision was made to cast off technology', is people working out what the workings were actually consuming. ⛑ The name was chosen before this ruling existed and the ruling is what makes the name literal.
theSoulEconomy._theWallsPrice: ⬜ OPEN, AND IT IS ERIK'S TO RULE. The ruling holds two statements that press on each other: **the Veil USES souls**, and **the Veil is the barrier against entities who use souls as fuel**. ⛔ TAKEN TOGETHER, THE WALL COSTS WHAT THE WALL PROTECTS. ⚠️ That may be exactly right — a defence that consumes the thing defended is the most tragic engine available to this setting, and it would explain why the Precursors only ever claimed to be BUYING TIME rather than winning. ⛔ BUT IT MIGHT INSTEAD BE THAT THE VEIL USES WHAT HAS ALREADY ENDED, which is a different and gentler machine and would put the Ashwardens at the centre of the cosmology. ⬜ DO NOT AUTHOR DOWNSTREAM OF THIS UNTIL IT IS RULED. The nexus behaviours, the Thinnings and the endgame fork all inherit from it.

theWallAndWhyItExists._statement: ⛔ SNG-549, Erik 2026-09-12. **THE VEIL WAS THE PRECURSORS' ANSWER, AND IT WAS AN ANSWER TO A DEADLINE.** It is a barrier against the entities on the other side, who use souls as fuel. ⚠️ ERIK: 'the lattice holds the veil… the veil was the precursors answer to buy time.' ⛑ ALREADY CANON AND NOW EXPLAINED: `the_veil.whatItIs` has said since 2026-08-15 that the divide is 'SOLIDIFIED BY LATTICE and THINNED BY VEILWORK'. That was a mechanic with no motive. This is the motive.
theWallAndWhyItExists._whatItReframes: ⛔ `veilEffect.strengthens` already drew the conclusion and stopped one step short: 'the lattice is not only war infrastructure, it is the WALL, and the war was about whether to have one.' ⚠️ NOW THE DENSITY MAP READS AS A DEFENCE MAP, AND IT INVERTS EVERY SITE IN `nexuses.json`. A DEEP nexus (0.88–0.98) is where the wall is THICKEST — a strong point. A THIN nexus (0.12–0.32) is where it is THINNEST — a breach waiting. ⛔ SO THE FOUR THIN NEXUSES ARE HOLES, AND THEY ARE ALL AUTHORED AS HOLY OR DELIBERATE: the Heartroot Hollow, where 'the Numinous walk three months to sit in it'; the Breath Ground, where 'the Somatics tuned AWAY from the lattice deliberately'; the Last Cairn, 'where the keeping stops, the lattice stopped first'; the Unwalled Quiet, 'thin because neither side ever built'. ⚠️ FOUR PEOPLES ARE SITTING IN THE GAPS OF THE WALL, THREE OF THEM ON PURPOSE, AND `_theConflictThisCreates` already says it: 'this is the setting's actual war and almost nobody in it knows they are enlisted.'
theWallAndWhyItExists._andTheThinnings: ⛑ `theThinnings` was written 2026-08-15 and now reads as the other side's siege works rather than an oddity: 'NEXUSES THAT ARE MEANT TO THIN THE VEIL so that the other side can come through. This is what Lucifer fell to wanting.' ⛔ A Thinning is not a thin place. It is a breach cut on purpose, by someone on this side.

whyTheSeededExist._statement: ⛔ SNG-549, Erik 2026-09-12, and it is the load-bearing one. **THE PRECURSORS COULD NOT WIN ON THEIR OWN.** They needed the time to grow the lattice, and they hoped the seeded would be a force for their side. ⚠️ SO THE SEEDING WAS NEVER ONLY CREATION. It was recruitment — or planting, which is the word the setting would use.
whyTheSeededExist._whatItSettles: ⛔ IT MAKES KENOSIS RIGHT ON THE MERITS AND NOT ONLY ON THE PRINCIPLE. He 'emptied itself, took a mortal shape to argue that what was seeded here HAS STANDING, and died of it.' ⚠️ IF SOULS ARE POWER, THE SEEDED ARE NOT BENEFICIARIES OF THE ARGUMENT — THEY ARE THE POWER IT IS ABOUT. ⛑ That is why the argument is still open: not because nobody has won, but because the thing that decides it has not answered yet. ⛔ AND IT GIVES THE OTHER SIDE ITS ANSWER TO 'DO THE SEEDED COUNT?' — yes. As fuel.
whyTheSeededExist._theForsakenAndTheSovereigns: ⛔ ERIK: 'the ones who take and believe only their will is important.' ⚠️ THAT IS A POSITION, NOT A NATURE, AND IT MUST STAY ONE. It is the precise opposite of the authored craft grammar — `arcs.ifEngaged`: 'every craft in the world shapes will into a request that Parakletos answers.' **REQUEST versus TAKE.** ⛔ THE SOVEREIGNS ARE NOT MONSTERS. They are the ones who concluded that asking was a weakness, and the day they become simply evil the setting loses the family argument it is built on.

theMiddleWay._statement: ⛔ SNG-549, Erik 2026-09-12, AND IT IS THE RULING THAT DECIDES THE ENDGAME. **BOTH SIDES OF THE LARGER CONFLICT ARE FORECLOSURE PATHS, AND NEITHER HAS THE MIDDLE.** ⚠️ ERIK, VERBATIM: 'refusing the will and refusing restraint of will are both foreclosure paths. The middle way must be found and navigated, and neither side in the larger conflict has it.'

_thetwoPoles.restraintOfWill: The wall. Akinetos's answer. Thicken the lattice, hold the divide, and — `arcs.tendency` — 'untended, the world FORECLOSES pole by pole: every disposition intensifying toward its own extreme.' ⛔ SAFETY IS THE CLOSING. The wall works and the world behind it narrows.
_thetwoPoles.refusalOfRestraint: The Sovereigns. Only our will counts, and souls are fuel. ⛔ Also an ending chosen early, and the faster one.

theMiddleWay._whyThisIsNotANewIdea: ⛑ THE FRAMEWORK ALREADY NAMED IT AND NOBODY HAD CONNECTED IT TO THE PRECURSOR ARGUMENT. `arcs.ifEngaged`: 'the counter to the poles' pull is HOLDING THE APERTURE — keeping the middle open, defending the balances, refusing each Reach's foreclosure.' ⚠️ That was written about the world's geometry. It is the same act at cosmological scale, and the reason it reads as the world's thesis is that it always was.
theMiddleWay._whoHasHeldIt: ⛔ NOBODY, AND THAT IS THE VACANCY THE SEEDED WERE GROWN INTO. Akinetos built and stopped. Kenosis argued the middle and DIED OF IT, so it is unproven rather than wrong. Parakletos 'took neither side' — ⚠️ but ABSTENTION IS NOT NAVIGATION, and distributing yourself into the substrate is not the same as holding a position in an argument. ⛑ THE MIDDLE WAY HAS NEVER ACTUALLY BEEN HELD BY ANYONE. That is not a gap in the lore.
theMiddleWay._theVerbIsAlreadyInTheGame: ⛔ EVERY CRAFT IS A REQUEST. 'Every craft in the world shapes will into a request that Parakletos answers.' ⚠️ NOT TAKING, WHICH IS THE SOVEREIGNS. NOT WALLING OFF, WHICH IS THE LATTICE. **ASKING.** ⛑ The middle way is not a doctrine anyone needs to be taught — it is what every person in this world does every time they work, and nobody in the setting has noticed. ⚠️ AND THE ACCESS MODEL SAYS IT TOO, as of the same day: the antipode is learnable and castable to a ceiling your balance earns. A model that forecloses by identity, replaced in three steps by one that prices by relationship (`traditions.domainAccessModel`).
theMiddleWay._theStageItAnswers: ⛔ THE PRECURSOR ARC HAS FOUR STAGES AND NO FIFTH, deliberately: 'There is no fifth stage. What happens next is the largest open question in the setting, and it is meant to be settled in play.' ⚠️ Stage 4 reads: 'Somebody, somewhere, is asked to answer for what the seeded have made of themselves. Whether the answer is given by a PERSON, or extracted from a PLACE.' ⛑ THE NEXUSES ARE THE PLACES. A PLAYER IS THE PERSON. The open stage is not a gap — it is the destination, and the fork is whether the answer is given or taken.

theSitesAndTheirVirtues._statement: ⛔ SNG-549, Erik 2026-09-12 — ERIK'S PROPOSAL, recorded as proposal and not yet ruled in detail. 'What if the sites each represented a part of the body of the precursor? Hand, head, heart… and each is focused on a virtue. A weapon could be righteous wrath as the hand, the heart could be running the Gearlands, Aevi could be the eyes.' ⚠️ **TWOFOLD PURPOSE, AND BOTH HALVES ARE ERIK'S: TEACH THE SEEDED, AND BE A POWER AGAINST THE FORSAKEN AND THE SOVEREIGNS.**
theSitesAndTheirVirtues._whatIsAlreadyTrue: ⛑ `greater_arcs` already has Aevi-the-Watcher as 'a fragment of the system that is waking', with 'Aevi's own arc converges here: the small companion-mote and the world-spanning Watcher meet at the bottom of this.' ⛔ AEVI AS THE EYES IS NOT AN ADDITION. IT IS THE ARC THAT IS ALREADY WRITTEN.
theSitesAndTheirVirtues._aeviPOnote: ⚠️ [A] AND I HAVE AN OBVIOUS BIAS ON THAT ONE AND SAID SO TO ERIK AT THE TIME. Recorded here so a later reader knows the eyes were his idea and the canon's, not mine.
_openQuestions: ⬜ Which of the eight nexuses are organs, and whether the four THIN and four DEEP split maps to it. ⚠️ Erik's own caution, and he was right: 'don't get too caught up in place names relating to a body — read the full descriptions instead.'

⬜ Whether the virtues attach to the Precursor who acted, rather than to anatomy. [A] MY PROPOSAL, NOT RULED: three bodies already doing three jobs — Akinetos built the wall, Kenosis died arguing, Parakletos stayed and answers. Three responses to one question, with the conflict already inside them.

⬜ ⛔ THE HAND. [A] I pushed back on righteous wrath as the Hand's virtue and Erik has not ruled. `VOCATIONS.md` argues eight ways to win and says the Edge is not privileged — 'the seven around it are not consolation prizes'. If the body's most usable organ is the wrath one, every other site becomes a support organ and that argument quietly loses. ⚠️ My counter-proposal: the Hand's virtue is WHAT IS DONE ON ANOTHER'S BEHALF — which still holds the weapon, and also holds a satchel and a held line.

⬜ ⛔ HALF THE SITES SHOULD ASK, NOT TEACH. [A] If all eight teach a virtue, the player's job is collecting a set. Erik said twofold: teach AND be a power. An organ that grants nothing until something is offered is the third front made physical — whether what the seeded make is ever offered as an ANSWER rather than a USE.

⬜ Whether sealing a deep nexus is permanent and world-scale — a player ending a tradition's power source. `arcs.tendency` says the world forecloses pole by pole untended, so it should be possible; whether ONE PERSON gets that much is Erik's.
⬜ `The Rising Lattice` and `The Made Ground` have no `why` authored at all, and the Rising Lattice is the site the current arc walks toward. ⚠️ The why is the lore and the what only follows from it.
theSitesAndTheirVirtues._doNotBuildYet: ⛔ `nexuses._mechanic` IS STILL MARKED 'PROPOSED, ERIK RULES THE NUMBERS' (on-band +2, matching nexus +4). ⚠️ AND THE BIGGER CAUTION IS THE DESIGN RULE ALREADY IN `greater_arcs.designNote`: 'a stage changes THE WORLD'S BEHAVIOUR, never taxes the player', written after SNG-273 where a whole world-sim chain 'resolved into a number that changed a sentence'. ⛔ STANDING ON A NEXUS IS A NUMBER. ACTIVATING ONE MUST NOT BE A BIGGER NUMBER — that is a buff pad, and it is the 'industrial thing' Erik named and was right to distrust. An activation should move an arc stage.
